title: Frontend: Generate Password
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Generate Password. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({draws?}). Length input defaults 8, valid integers 4..32. Generate guarantees one character from each ab, AB, 01, ! class, fills from the combined alphabet, then Fisher–Yates shuffles. Use rejection-sampled crypto randomness unless fractional draws are injected and cycled. Show password in [data-testid=password] with data-length; invalid length clears output and shows Invalid length.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Use a cryptographic random source and unbiased bounded sampling.
alternativeApproaches: Explain rejection sampling and why modulo reduction can bias a character distribution.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: No classes; invalid length; class coverage.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
